import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Res {
        long ways, sum;
        Res() {
            ways = 0;
            sum = 0;
        }
        Res(long w, long s) {
            ways = w;
            sum = s;
        }
    }

    static int n_components, n_people, mod_value;
    static int[][] C;
    static boolean[] visited2;
    static Res[] memo2;
    static boolean[][] visited1;
    static Res[][] memo1;

    static int calcSum(int a, int b) {
        return (a + b) * (b - a + 1) / 2;
    }

    static Res compute2(int n) {
        if (n == 1) return new Res(2, 0);
        if (visited2[n]) return memo2[n];
        Res res = new Res(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            int leftCount = i;
            int rightCount = n - i - 1;
            Res leftRes = (leftCount == 0) ? new Res(1, 0) : compute2(leftCount);
            Res rightRes = (rightCount == 0) ? new Res(1, 0) : compute2(rightCount);
            int ways = (leftCount + 1) + (rightCount + 1);
            int sumAdd = calcSum(0, leftCount) + calcSum(0, rightCount);
            int mlt = C[leftCount + rightCount][leftCount];
            res.ways = (res.ways + (leftRes.ways * ways % mod_value) * rightRes.ways % mod_value) % mod_value;
            res.sum = (res.sum + (leftRes.sum * ways % mod_value) * rightRes.ways
                       + (leftRes.ways * sumAdd % mod_value) * rightRes.ways
                       + (leftRes.ways * ways % mod_value) * rightRes.sum) % mod_value;
        }
        visited2[n] = true;
        memo2[n] = res;
        return res;
    }

    static Res compute1(int idx, int cnt) {
        if (n_components - idx == cnt) return compute2(cnt);
        if (visited1[idx][cnt]) return memo1[idx][cnt];
        Res res = new Res(0, 0);
        for (int i = idx; i < n_components; ++i) {
            int leftCount = i - idx;
            int rightCount = cnt - leftCount;
            if (rightCount < 0 || rightCount > n_components - i - 1) continue;
            Res leftRes = (i == idx) ? new Res(1, 0) : compute2(leftCount);
            Res rightRes = (i + 1 == n_components) ? new Res(1, 0) : compute1(i + 1, rightCount);
            int mlt = C[leftCount + rightCount][leftCount];
            res.ways = (res.ways + (leftRes.ways * rightRes.ways % mod_value) * mlt) % mod_value;
            res.sum = (res.sum + (leftRes.sum * rightRes.ways % mod_value) * mlt
                       + (leftRes.ways * rightRes.sum % mod_value) * mlt) % mod_value;
        }
        visited1[idx][cnt] = true;
        memo1[idx][cnt] = res;
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int ncomp = sc.nextInt();
        int npers = sc.nextInt();
        int MOD = sc.nextInt();

        n_components = ncomp;
        n_people = npers;
        mod_value = MOD;

        C = new int[ncomp + 1][ncomp + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= ncomp; ++i) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            C[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; ++j) {
                C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j]) % MOD;
            }
        }

        visited2 = new boolean[ncomp + 1];
        memo2 = new Res[ncomp + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= ncomp; ++i) {
            memo2[i] = new Res();
        }

        visited1 = new boolean[ncomp + 1][npers + 1];
        memo1 = new Res[ncomp + 1][npers + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= ncomp; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= npers; ++j) {
                memo1[i][j] = new Res();
            }
        }

        System.out.println(compute1(0, n_people).sum);
        sc.close();
    }
}
